limitations: Ground Rebel uses the Source 2 version of the original agent mesh and rifle animation clips.
IDF uses a CS:GO community port; rifle movement is retargeted, not original Source 1 animation playback.
Death, aim response, breathing and first-person weapon IK are authored reconstructions; PBR materials approximate Source shaders.

viewArms.groundRebel: Native firstperson_default_gloves_arms and trimmed firstperson_sleeves meshes, original UVs and fingerless gloves
viewArms.idf: Arm surfaces extracted from the original skinned IDF uniform/hand mesh
viewArms.animation: Original weighted meshes follow authored weapon tracks through two-bone IK; these are not native Valve viewmodel animation clips
